meta.name: Swerve Combat
meta.description:
Swerve Combat delivers non-stop action with boxing, MMA, wrestling, and strength competitions along with gripping stories about the world’s most inspirational athletes.

Shows: BKB Bare Knuckle 56: Ortiz vs Salcido, GLORY Spotlight: Alex Pereira (Part 1), Best of BKB: Fight for the Ages: Irwin vs Tanori I, BKFC 56: Perry vs. Alvarez, Smack Fighting Championship 1
Available on: The Roku Channel, Plex
